summary.text: Danny Rosellini is the Republican candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 115 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Cassandra Garcia Hernandez.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a political outsider, small business owner and investor.

paragraphs.text: Rosellini advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
In his Ballotpedia survey, he said his priority is to "Protect Texas Families" and small businesses from rising costs, including energy and water bills, homeowner insurance and property taxes.
He also called for structural reform of the school system, putting funding into classrooms, and insurance reform for auto, home and health coverage.
